blocks.text:
Leave for Barreirinhas at 07:00. The drive takes about four hours through northeastern Maranhão, past palm groves, small settlements and stretches of red earth.

Barreirinhas stands on the Preguiças River and is the starting point for Lençóis Maranhenses National Park. The park is known for its vast white dunes. After the rainy season, clear blue and greenish lagoons remain between the dunes.

At 14:00, head into the national park by jeep. The route leads through the dunes to the Blue Lagoon, where you can swim or walk along the dune ridges. As the evening light softens, the lagoons reflect the sky and the contours of the dunes stand out at sunset.

The journey through the park is part of the experience. The jeeps cross sandy, open stretches before you continue on foot. Beyond each ridge, another lagoon or line of white dunes comes into view. After the wet forests, marshes and clear rivers of the previous days, this vast sandy landscape comes as a surprise.

Back in Barreirinhas, you can relax in the hotel pool, take a walk through town or have dinner at a riverside restaurant.
